sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that Torah study also brings about a new influence, like prayer, but through the automatic effect of the Torah scholar's ruling, combining the advantages of both prayer and blessing.

translations.translation: Now, this concept that in prayer
(through which a new influence is drawn down)
is also present in a general way in Torah.
For through a ruling of Torah law, a change is brought about in the world22
[a new thing is made that did not exist even in the root and source of the world],
this is,
because Torah is above the root of the world
(for Torah is His wisdom, blessed be He, which is above the wisdom of the act of Creation),
therefore,
through a ruling of Torah law, a change and renewal is made in the world.
And thus,
in Torah there are two virtues,
the virtue of prayer – drawing down a new matter,
and the virtue of blessing23.
For the change and renewal made in the world through the ruling of the Torah scholar who engages in Torah is
(not in the manner of a request as in prayer,
but rather)
in an automatic manner.
And as is known24
regarding the concept of "Who are the kings? The Rabbis"25,
that because their Torah study is in a state of self-nullification,
their rulings are that the King Himself
(the King of kings, the Holy One, blessed be He)
decrees and speaks the ruling,
and since this is a decree of the King,
it is done automatically.
And similarly regarding the miracles performed by the Tannaim and Amoraim through their Torah study26,
such as Rebbe Pinchas ben Yair who said, "Ginnai River, divide your waters for me"27,
that in this there are two virtues.
A change and renewal in the river
(which is not even in its root and source28)
– the virtue of prayer,
and that the change in the river was made through the command of Rebbe Pinchas ben Yair – the virtue of blessing.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that despite Torah's advantage, prayer is superior because it draws a new will from Ein Sof that is above even the wisdom of Torah, as exemplified by Rashbi's miracle of bringing rain through a Torah discourse.

translations.translation: Nevertheless, prayer has an advantage over Torah,
for Torah is wisdom,
and wisdom
(even the wisdom of Torah, which is above the wisdom of the act of Creation)
is incomparable relative to Ein Sof,
and through prayer one draws down a new will from Ein Sof that is above even the wisdom of Torah29.
Based on this, it can be said,
that the novelty in that Rashbi brought down rain through his Torah statement, compared to the awesome miracles30
performed by several Tannaim and Amoraim through their Torah study,
is,
that the change in the world made by all the Tannaim and Amoraim was by drawing down and revealing that it is so according to the wisdom of Torah31,
and the novelty of the rain falling through Rashbi's statement of the discourse on the verse "Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to dwell together in unity,"
is,
that although the discourse he said pertained only to the matter of rain32
in general, but there was no hint in it that the world was then worthy of rain,
and thus, even according to the wisdom of Torah
(which is above the root of the world)
the world was not worthy of rain,
and that rain fell then through the utterance of the discourse is because through the utterance of the discourse he drew down from Ein Sof that is above the wisdom of Torah,
similar to the drawing down that occurs through prayer.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that because the inner dimension of Torah reveals Ein Sof, and Rashbi was the source of this inner dimension, his Torah study drew down Ein Sof in a revealed way, above Torah itself.

translations.translation: And it can be said,
that this drawing down from Ein Sof that is above the wisdom of Torah, which occurred through Rashbi's Torah statement,
is,
because in the inner dimension of Torah, Ein Sof shines in a revealed way33,
and since Rashbi was the source of the inner dimension of Torah
[and even in his study of the revealed dimension, the inner dimension shone34],
therefore, through his Torah statement he drew down Ein Sof in a revealed way, which is above Torah.
